# About the ICSC
The [bold]Independent Core System Colonies[/bold] are a union of free, self-governing human worlds. Most of our members lie in the [bold]New Eden Sector[/bold] of the Core Systems. Others hold on in the Outer Veil and out on the frontier, worlds like this one. The ring on our seal is every member world, linked to its neighbours and to the Core. No world in the ring stands above another.
## Where We Came From - We began as the [bold]Central Space Consortium[/bold], a network of corporate colonies chartered under the Three World Empire. - In [bold]2148[/bold] the Consortium declared its independence. Colonial Marines and Royal Marine Commandos were sent to bring us back. The Core Conflict lasted until 2150. - In [bold]2151[/bold] the UNISC brokered the [bold]'51 New Deal[/bold]. Many colonies were returned to the TWE. The rest of the Consortium was recognised as the self-governing ICSC. - Families on both sides still remember the war. We do not ask anyone to forget it, only to not repeat it.
## How We Are Governed - Each member world keeps its own government and its own laws. Many of those governments answer to corporate boards. We do not hide it; it is how the Consortium was built. - Common affairs are run by the [bold]Board of Ministries[/bold], which appoints ambassadors such as the one posting here. - The [bold]ICSC Defense Force[/bold] guards our space. It does not garrison other powers' colonies. - The [bold]EntaCOMM Network[/bold] carries messages almost instantly across most of colonised space. It holds our worlds together, and anyone may use it for a fee.
## On Earth Our presence on the home world is small: enclaves in Persia, France, Korea, Turkey and Pakistan. Most governments do not recognise us. To them we are secessionists. We will keep acting like a government until that changes.
